title: Gupta–Rai conjecture on permutation trinomials over finite fields
statement:
Let $q=p^k$, where $p>7$ is a prime and $k>1$, and let $ff$ be the finite field with $q$ elements. For $alpha\inff^*$, define

$$
f(X)=X^{q(p-1)+1}+\alpha X^{pq}+X^{q+p-1}.
$$

**Gupta–Rai conjecture.** The trinomial $f(X)$ is a permutation polynomial over $\mathbb F_{q^2}$ if and only if $\alpha=-1$ and $k=2$.
This conjecture concerns the permutation behaviour of a family of trinomials over quadratic extensions of finite fields. Earlier work establishes related classifications in characteristics $3$, $5$, and $7$, while the case $p>7$ and $k>1$ is the proposed general case.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.22692

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
source_name: Daniele Bartoli, Mohit Pal and Pantelimon Stanica, “A proof of a conjecture on permutation trinomials”, arXiv:2410.22692 (2024).
